card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: Digits, decimal points and closing parentheses inside numbered section references such as (7.1), (2.1) or (9.2) in drug label highlights. It responds in the cross-reference after a sentence, or in a bracketed 'see' pointer.

modes.label: Subsection digit
modes.description: The digit after the decimal point in a section reference.

modes.label: Closing parenthesis
modes.description: The closing bracket right after a section number such as 2.1.
modes.example: ( 2.1<< )>> Should be administered by a healthcare provider.

modes.label: Point in bracketed reference
modes.description: The decimal point or digit inside a bracketed 'see' pointer to another section.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word-like tokens fig, gif and the Chinese character for 'figure' being suppressed, so it does not predict figure references after the number.
card.plain: It fires on the small section numbers in parentheses, like (7.1), that point to another part of the drug label.
